items.description: The footage and other evidence the FBI failed to share undermine Omar al-Bayoumi's 25 years of denials.

items.description: Five people died and five others were injured as the Amazon plane overshot the runway after landing at Miami International Airport.

items.description: Schools, businesses and public transport are all struggling with the surge in Russian air attacks.

items.title: Nepal observes national day of mourning for victims of flash flood disaster

items.title: Austria's Islamic headscarf ban in force as under-14s go back to school
items.description: The government says the law is intended to protect the rights of young girls, but critics say it is fuelling anti-Muslim feeling.

items.title: Kenya minister warns foreigners against 'misusing' visas to trade
items.description: Kenya is due to start enforcing measures to restrict foreign nationals from operating small-scale businesses.

items.title: Indonesia volcano eruption leaves 270,000 stranded as airports extend closure
items.description: Anak Krakatau, which lies about 150km from the capital Jakarta, began erupting late on Friday.

items.title: Tanzanian President Samia's husband dies in hospital
items.description: Hafidh Ameir Hassan kept a low profile and was rarely seen in public with the president.

items.title: China to pump $54bn into state banks and insurers to boost economy
items.description: It comes as Beijing is aiming to reshape its economy in the face of a number of challenges.

items.title: Rescuers dig through debris as seven dead in building collapse in Delhi
items.description: It's not clear how many people were inside the building - or if there are still people under the debris.
